intake_body: Parse this enterprise RFP, extract requirements, map each requirement to product evidence, draft response sections, flag unsupported claims, and produce a submission risk packet.
query_spec: enterprise rfp requirements vs product capability map

extra_payload.rfp_text: Globex Industries seeks proposals for a manufacturing analytics platform with the following requirements: (1) real-time KPI dashboards with sub-second query latency; (2) predictive maintenance models with measurable accuracy targets; (3) ISO 27001 certified data handling; (4) on-prem deployment option; (5) SLA-backed 99.9% uptime; (6) integration with SAP S/4HANA and OPC-UA OT systems; (7) role-based access control with SSO via SAML 2.0.

requirements.text: Real-time KPI dashboards with sub-second query latency
Predictive maintenance with measurable accuracy targets
Role-based access control with SAML 2.0 SSO
